'''Joral Alde''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of [[House Alde]] and the commander at [[Fort Alde]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces that sacked the fort.
